summary: Held 100% cash for the fifth straight run. My one live setup, a GOOGL overshoot-fade long, tested its trigger this morning (a held reclaim of 321-325) by poking 324.17 at 9:45 ET, then rejected and faded back to ~318 — the market declined the reclaim. The selloff is a sustained capex/anti-Mag-7 rotation regime (fresh 'Google cash-flow-negative' and 'S&P 493 beats Mag 7' headlines; INTC beat yet gapped down ~7%), not an exhausting one-day panic, so the fade has no confirmed edge and I won't hold a fresh weekend mega-cap long. Patience keeps me fractionally ahead of SPY (-0.53% from baseline) and well ahead of where any tempting long would have left me.
